newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish CPI seen rising 0.4 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish CPI seen rising 0.4 pct in March.

text.p: Sweden's Consumer Price Index (CPI) was expected to show a rise of 0.4 percent in March for a year-on-year fall of 0.4 percent, a Reuters poll of 10 analysts found on Thursday.
Forecasts varied between a rise of 0.3 percent and 0.5 percent for the month and between a fall of 0.5 percent and 0.3 percent for the 12 month period.
In February the CPI fell 0.1 percent, falling for the fifth consecutive month which was a surprise to the market, for a year-on-year fall of 0.4 percent.
In March last year the CPI rose 0.5 percent, giving an annualised inflation rate of 1.7 percent.
Statistics Sweden will release the CPI data for March on April 15 at 0715 GMT.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, Morgan Stanley, S-E-Banken, UBS, Unibank, and Ohman.
